verdict.rationale: Marqeta's agentic-AI MCP guide names instant-issue virtual card issuance and spend controls (velocity limits, spending caps, merchant restrictions) as agent capabilities. The Core API documents merchant-scoped authorization controls and amount/frequency velocity controls. However, the evidence frames agents as operators of the platform, not as cardholders, so the specific use of giving an agent its own card for autonomous purchases is not documented by name. Missing for 10: card expiry or time-boxed scoping, explicit documentation of an agent-as-cardholder purchasing use case, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
